definitions.saturation: mean HSV S of encoded RGB, black S=0
definitions.linear_Y: mean BT.709 Y after piecewise sRGB decoding
definitions.encoded_Yprime: mean dot(encoded RGB, BT.709 weights); NOT physical luminance
definitions.gamma: y=x^gamma, fixed gain/offset; least squares in log space; x,y in (.02,.98)
definitions.deltas: absolute RGB byte difference; no registration, resized PNG or colour transform
definitions.bar_band: x < width/2, y < height/8; includes neutral bar patches
definitions.neutral: source HSV S <= .05; rest_of_scene is a separate, coloured region
